verdict.rationale: Google Cloud publishes official MCP servers. Cloud Run has a documented MCP server reference and a GoogleCloudPlatform cloud-run-mcp repo for deploying apps. The googleapis MCP Toolbox for Databases is an open-source MCP server that lets Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and other MCP clients connect to databases, and the probe confirms the official Cloud Run MCP docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting successfully, detailed connection and auth setup docs, and evidence of MCP coverage beyond Cloud Run and databases.
